entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to arrange a return for a VeloBand GPS Tracker I received a couple of weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your order, could I please have your name and order number?
Of course. The name is Alex Chen, order number 774-VFT-9012.

Thank you, Alex. I have your order right here for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 24th. Now, to help me understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault, or more of a personal preference?
Oh, there's nothing wrong with it at all. It's still sealed in the box. I just realized I probably won't use it. When I tried to start the return online, the system said it was too late.

I see. Yes, for our new VeloBand Pulse, there is a strict 10-day return policy. This is because once the device is activated it links to a user's account, and for hygiene reasons, we can't accept them back after that initial period. Since it's been 16 days, the system has correctly flagged it as outside the standard return window.

I understand the policy, but I was hoping there might be some flexibility. The thing is, my brother is in the military. His pre-deployment leave was cut short by a medical emergency. He required immediate surgery, and our whole family has basically been living at the hospital with him for the last two weeks. This is the first chance I've had to address this.
Oh my, I am so sorry to hear about your brother. That sounds incredibly stressful. Please send him our best wishes for a swift recovery, and please thank him for his service.
Thank you, I appreciate that. So, considering the situation, is a full refund completely off the table? I'd be willing to accept store credit if that's a better option for you.

Thank you for being so forthcoming, Alex. At VeloFit, we absolutely make exceptions for extenuating circumstances like a verified medical emergency or military family situations. I can see you're a VIP member with us as well. I am more than happy to make a one-time exception and authorize a full refund to your original payment method.
Are you sure? That's fantastic. I really appreciate you working with me on this.

It's my pleasure. The last thing you need is more stress during a difficult time. I've just processed the return authorization and I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to your email now. Simply attach it to the box and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been a great help, Diana. Thank you so much.
You are very welcome, Alex. Please take care, and we hope to see you again at VeloFit soon. Have a good day.
